description:
Russell tells the story of dressing up as Willy Wonka on top of a bus at the end of the Olympics, singing Come With Me in front of everyone, only for his overly tight trousers to rip open right before he went on. His emergency fix, actual Scotch tape from a Walmart checkout, folded so many times it started stabbing him in an extremely uncomfortable place mid performance. A genuinely hilarious story about a costume malfunction that couldn't have gone worse.
